answer: The crystal register is checked at draw time, beacon lists the eligible set, and juniper seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary burns for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 76 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 16 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
